```yaml
name: Performance Benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: true

    steps:
      - name: Checkout PR and main branches
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Build PR branch
        working-directory: ./pr_branch
        run: git checkout ${{ github.head_ref }} && npm run build

      - name: Build main branch
        working-directory: ./main_branch
        run: git checkout main && npm run build

      - name: Run benchmark
        id: benchmark
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: "Performance Benchmark"
          tool: "node"
          output-file-path: "./results.json"
          gh-pages-branch: "gh-pages"
          gh-repository: "yamadashy/repomix"
          benchmark-data-dir-path: "./data"
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          auto-push: true
          skip-fetch-gh-pages: false
          comment-always: true
          summary-always: true
          save-data-file: true
          comment-on-alert: false
          alert-threshold: 0.1

      - name: Post benchmark results
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "::set-output name=comment::$(cat results.json | jq '.comment')"
        shell: bash

      - name: Add or update PR comment
        if: always()
        uses: thollander/actions-comment-pull-request@e4a76dd2b0a3c2027c3fd84147a67c22ee4c90fa
        with:
          message: ${{ steps.benchmark.outputs.comment }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          pr-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
```
